answers.rationale: Protein is down (padj<0.05). The CPTAC RNA reference is down, but TCGA RNA is significantly up, so replication fails. RCC has the largest transcript share, but the purity interval includes 0. No surface record. The proteome reports vital enrichment. DepMap shows 0 dependent lines.

Protein is up. CPTAC RNA, TCGA RNA and confirmatory protein all agree in direction. RCC has the largest share and the purity lower bound is about 3.2. Surface call is surface. Vital IHC level is 1 and the proteome is not enriched. DepMap has no dependent lines.

Protein is up, and TCGA RNA replicates the CPTAC RNA direction. CD8_T has a larger transcript share (0.6) than RCC (0.2), so tumour_intrinsic is no, which gives infiltration_signal. Surface call is surface. Vital IHC level is 1 and no proteome record reports enrichment. DepMap padj is 0.39.

Protein is up. CPTAC and TCGA RNA are both strongly up. RCC has a 0.976 share and the purity lower bound is positive (about 6.65). Surface call is surface. Vital IHC level is 1 and the proteome is not enriched. DepMap shows 0 dependent lines.
